regions.region: title, abstract, and introduction in both columns
regions.finding: The abstract gives broad scope claims only. The introduction identifies cited prior selenochlorination, including the Macomber dimethyl-allenylphosphonate example; the cited example is classified as literature, not as a new batch from this paper.

regions.region: middle-right Scheme 1, both reaction arrows
regions.finding: Two generic transformations were inventoried separately: prior E-selective halo/selenohydroxylation and this-work Z-selective PhSeCl selenochlorination. Both remain general_scheme records with generic R groups and no invented batch yield.

regions.region: lower-right opening Results and Discussion
regions.finding: The prose reports the Table 1 entry-1 experiment (33% Z-2a plus 36% 3a) and previews the distinct MeCN/H2O 3:1 entry; numeric row details are reconciled with page 2 rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Scheme 1 structures are generic and cannot support fully specified SMILES.
The linked Supporting Information is mentioned by the paper but was not explicitly provided or associated in this workspace.
Table 1 continues on page 2; page-1 prose alone does not establish every row field.

regions.region: upper full-width Table 1, reaction drawing, rows 1--11, and footnotes a--c
regions.finding: All 11 optimization rows were extracted independently with PhSeCl equivalents, solvent/water system, temperature, time, product-specific isolated yields, product ratio, and impurity footnote. Rows 6 and 10 are the same conditions/outcomes later repeated in Table 2 and detailed procedures, so they were merged across evidence rather than duplicated.

regions.region: middle-left Table 1 discussion
regions.finding: Narrative statements about exclusive 2a formation and solvent screening were used as corroboration; no extra experiments were created beyond the table rows.

regions.region: middle-right Table 2, reaction drawing, rows 1--10, and footnotes
regions.finding: Ten scope rows were inventoried. The two 1a rows merge with Table 1 rows 10 and 6 respectively; the remaining eight rows are independent substrate-scope records. Later detailed batch quantities replace no table facts; explicit scale conflicts are preserved as unresolved notes.

regions.region: lower two-column stereochemistry discussion and page-break continuation
regions.finding: The page previews the p-bromophenyl and dimethyl control experiments and reports that both 1-phenyl- and 3-phenyl allenylphosphonate reactions became complicated. The two failed/complex substrate experiments are separate partial records; Scheme 2 supplies their control-experiment details on page 3.

unresolved: Table 1 entries 3, 4, 7, and 8 contain an unidentified impurity inseparable from 3a.
The Table 2 table-wide 0.30 mmol scale conflicts with detailed 0.20 mmol batches for 1a, 1e, and 1g; the discrepancy is retained rather than guessed away.
The phenyl-substituted reactions have no stated product identity, time, or yield.

regions.region: upper Scheme 2 equations 1--3 and Conditions A/B annotations
regions.finding: Five current-paper batches (2i; 2j under A and B; 2k under A and B) were separated by substrate and condition. The 7 h/46% Macomber result was classified separately as a literature example, while the current 19 h/71% repetition is a reported experiment. Recovery of 1j under 2j Conditions B is stored as recovery, not product yield.

regions.region: middle Figure 1 ORTEP and Figure 2 NOE panels
regions.finding: These panels support stereochemical characterization of already recorded products 2j and 2m; they do not depict new reaction batches and therefore generate no duplicate experiment records.

regions.region: middle-left Scheme 3 equations 1--2
regions.finding: Two scale-up batches were extracted independently: 4.8 mmol 1a to Z-2a (72%) and 5.5 mmol 1j to Z-2l (80%). The first is linked to its detailed page-5 procedure.

regions.region: bottom Table 3, rows 1--4 and footnotes
regions.finding: Four independent 1-substituted-allenylphosphonate scope rows were extracted with both Z-2 and cyclic-3 product yields. Entry 2 uses the THF/H2O footnote override; the other rows use dioxane/H2O.

regions.region: right-column mechanistic prose and left-column continuation from page 2
regions.finding: The phenyl-substrate failure statement is completed, and the proposed selenonium-intermediate rationale is classified with Scheme 4 as mechanism rather than experimental evidence.

unresolved: The cited external Macomber paper was not supplied, so its 7 h/46% batch was not independently source-checked beyond this paper's citation.
Table 3 rows omit exact masses, atmosphere, workup, and purification.
Cyclic and stereochemical structures remain unverified machine interpretations despite ORTEP/NOE support.

regions.region: upper-left Scheme 4 and adjacent mechanism discussion
regions.finding: The network through proposed intermediates (E)-4 and (Z)-5, chloride attack, and O-attack is stored as one mechanism record. It is not treated as a measured experiment or assigned a yield.

regions.region: middle-left Table 4, rows 1--3 and footnotes
regions.finding: Three multisubstituted-allenylphosphonate rows were extracted independently. Entries 1 and 3 use the table's room-temperature header; entry 2 uses the 70 °C footnote override.

regions.region: lower-left Conclusions
regions.finding: The conclusions summarize the product-class split and introduce no additional batch experiment.

regions.region: right-column Experimental Section: Starting Materials and Typical Procedure I for 1e
regions.finding: The full preparation of 1e was extracted with reagent amounts, -78 °C addition, 15 min addition time, warm-to-room-temperature/reflux operation, workup, chromatography, product mass, and 73% isolated yield.

regions.region: lower-right abbreviated preparations of 1g and 1q
regions.finding: The two separate batches were extracted with their explicit quantities and outcomes and linked to Typical Procedure I. Unrestated duration details remain missing; 1q analytical characterization continues on page 5.

unresolved: The abbreviated 1g and 1q preparations do not restate exact addition or reaction durations.
Generic Scheme 4 substituents and proposed intermediates are not structure-verified.

regions.region: top-left continuation of 1q characterization
regions.finding: Only analytical characterization continues from page 4; it supports the existing 1q preparation record and does not create a new reaction batch.

regions.region: left-column Typical Procedure II and Typical Procedure III for Z-2a
regions.finding: The THF and dioxane batches match Table 1 entries 10 and 6 and Table 2 entries 1 and 2 respectively, so evidence was merged into two records. Workup and chromatography details were added; the Table 2 scale discrepancy remains explicit.

regions.region: left-bottom and right-top larger-scale 1a reaction
regions.finding: The 4.8 mmol scale-up is the same batch as Scheme 3 equation 1; its detailed additions, workup, 1.4637 g product mass, and 72% isolated yield were merged into that record.

regions.region: right-upper MeCN/H2O 3:1 experiment giving Z-2a and 3a
regions.finding: This explicit 0.30 mmol batch gives 18% Z-2a and 49% 3a (3a dr 35:65). Although nominal conditions/outcomes match Table 1 entry 2, the table specifies 0.20 mmol, so this batch remains a separate reported experiment.

regions.region: right-middle two Z-2b procedures and bottom cross-page start of Z-2c
regions.finding: The dioxane and THF Z-2b batches merge with Table 2 entries 4 and 3. The Z-2c batch begins here and continues on page 6; it is one cross-page record, not two.

unresolved: The relationship between the 0.30 mmol MeCN batch and 0.20 mmol Table 1 entry 2 is not stated.
Table 2's table-wide scale conflicts with the detailed 0.20 mmol 1a procedures.
Z-2c analytical and outcome text continues on page 6.

regions.region: upper-left continuation of Z-2c procedure and characterization
regions.finding: The cross-page Z-2c record is completed with 1.5 h at 70 °C, 77.7 mg isolated product, and 64% yield; no duplicate record was created.

regions.region: left-column Z-2d and Z-2e procedures
regions.finding: Two distinct THF/H2O scope batches were extracted and merged with Table 2 entries 6 and 7, preserving exact detailed quantities and the 66% and 68% isolated yields.

regions.region: right-column Z-2f, Z-2g, and Z-2h procedures
regions.finding: Three distinct THF/H2O scope batches were extracted and merged with Table 2 entries 8--10, including exact batch quantities, time, product mass, and isolated yield. The 1g substrate's stated 91% purity is structured as a participant amount.

regions.region: analytical characterization blocks throughout both columns
regions.finding: NMR/MS/IR/HRMS characterization supports product identity but is not represented as additional reaction experiments. The Z-2h characterization continues beyond page 6 and is not claimed as covered here.

unresolved: The detailed 1e and 1g batches use 0.20 mmol while Table 2 states a table-wide 0.30 mmol scale.
Z-2h characterization continues on page 7, outside the claimed coverage range.
